Alexandria, VA 22312 Phone: 800.553.6847 Fax: 703.605.6900 Email: info@ntis.gov Online ordering: http://www.osti.gov/ordering.htm Available electronically at http://www.osti.gov/ INTRODUCTION The purpose of this letter report is to document the mitigation of adverse effects of a proposed undertaking that would alter the roof of Building 06-CP-65 in Area 6 of the Nevada National Security Site (NNSS) in compliance with the stipulations in the Programmatic Agreement DE-GM58-22NA25554 Among the U.S. Department of Energy and the Nevada State Historic Preservation Officer and the Advisory Council on Historic Preservation Concerning the Protection of Historic Properties on the Nevada National Security Site, Nye County, Nevada, hereafter referred to as the NNSS PA. Building 06-CP-65 (State Historic Preservation Office [SHPO] Resource # B18910) is a contributing element to the Area 6 Control Point Historic District (SHPO Resource # D395), which has been determined eligible for listing in the National Register of Historic Places (NRHP) under Criteria A
